Advancement configuration/value and native links describe current source evidence, not an event history. Scores/items already present are not applied again or subtracted. No UUID lookup, formula, progression, respec or resource refill executes.

Only explicit HP, base ability scores, limited inventory, unconditional ability-add Effects, static base-cast Activities and scoped flat check inputs are normalized. Other Effects, expiry, recovery, formulas and unsupported system rules remain source-only. This is not a complete character sheet or rules engine.
